for (Order o : orders) { o.getItems().size(); } // lazy loading inside loop
DB QPS 320; p99 210ms; 应用 CPU 正常; 连接池 active 12/50
GET /orders took 980ms; 1 parent span + 1236 child DB spans

evidence.text: redis hit rate 15% (baseline 96%); key search:hot:query expired at 10:03:12
DB QPS 从 1200 升到 7600; 慢查询增加 6 倍
5400 个请求同时回源 search:hot:query; cache miss storm
cache stampede; add jitter, single-flight, or warm cache before expiry.

reference_answer: search-service：根因是缓存击穿。search:hot:query 过期后命中率从 96% 降到 15%，5400 个请求同时回源，DB QPS 从 1200 升到 7600。建议加 single-flight 与过期抖动。
